candidates.rule: The ranking forecast must use recent six-hour growth rates for the shop and the five ranking neighbors above and below, extrapolate to November 17 at 23:59, and recalculate percentiles using the existing core/score.py rules.
candidates.quote: 최근 6시간 증가 속도를 구해 11/17 23:59 값을 선형으로 늘리고, 백분위를 다시 계산한다(`core/score.py` 규칙 그대로).
candidates.harness: Calculate and display the forecasted percentiles using this method.

candidates.rule: The forecast must include the final ALL percentile change expected if an item is increased by X per day; that change determines strategic priority.
candidates.quote: **"이 항목을 하루 X만큼 더 올리면 최종 ALL이 몇 오르나"**. 이 값이 전략의 우선순위가 된다.
candidates.harness: Report the projected ALL change for each item and use it to rank priorities.

candidates.rule: During the first few hours, when sufficient history is unavailable, use board-ours.jsonl and the current snapshot instead, and label the forecast as an estimate.
candidates.quote: 이력이 쌓이기 전(첫 몇 시간)에는 `board-ours.jsonl`과 지금 스냅샷으로 대신하고 "추정"이라고 표시한다.
candidates.harness: Use the fallback data and mark early forecasts as estimates.

candidates.rule: The buyer score weights surplus at 0.5, votes at 0.3, posts at 0.1, and transaction count at 0.1.
candidates.quote: 구매자 잉여 (0.5) | 구매자 표 (0.3), 글 (0.1) | 구매자 거래 수 (0.1)
candidates.harness: Use these weights when analyzing buyer score priorities.

candidates.rule: The shop score weights net profit at 0.5, revenue at 0.3, and rating at 0.2.
candidates.quote: 가게 순이익 (0.5) | 가게 매출 (0.3) | 가게 별점 (0.2)
candidates.harness: Use these weights when analyzing shop score priorities.

candidates.rule: For buyer surplus, analyze conversion and failure reasons by item type, surplus per payment by price band, SKU/shop/grade for post-consent payment refusals, and whether top-buyer differences come from order composition or conversion; include the supporting row count.
candidates.quote: 종류별 결제 전환과 실패 이유 / 결제당 잉여(가격대별) / 동의 후 결제 거절의 SKU·가게·등급 / 상위 구매자와 차이: 주문 구성인가 전환인가
candidates.harness: Produce these buyer-surplus analyses with SQL and report the supporting row count.

candidates.rule: Analyze votes per post, the types of posts that received votes, and hidden posts; include the supporting row count.
candidates.quote: 글당 표, 표 받은 글의 종류, 숨겨진 글
candidates.harness: Answer these buyer vote and post questions from the analysis data.

candidates.rule: Analyze buyer payments per hour and payments relative to orders; include the supporting row count.
candidates.quote: 시간당 결제, 주문 대비
candidates.harness: Report both payment measures with the supporting row count.

candidates.rule: Analyze shop profit by SKU using margin times sales, losses from disposal, storage, and refunds, and inventory turnover; include the supporting row count.
candidates.quote: SKU별 마진×판매, 손실(폐기·보관·환불), 재고 회전
candidates.harness: Produce these shop-profit analyses with the supporting row count.

candidates.rule: Analyze missed requests caused by stockouts by SKU and amount, and the share of customers lost from the opening price; include the supporting row count.
candidates.quote: 재고 없음으로 놓친 요청의 SKU와 금액, 개장가에서 떠난 비율
candidates.harness: Report these shop-revenue diagnostics with the supporting row count.

candidates.rule: Classify causes of ratings of 3 or lower as food expiration, faults, or price, and count each cause; include the supporting row count.
candidates.quote: 3점 이하의 원인 분류 (식품 유통기한, 고장, 가격), 원인별 건수
candidates.harness: Report low-rating causes and counts.

candidates.rule: Briefings must contain the forecast summary, verdicts on previous changes, and only changed answers to analysis questions; health metrics are alerts only.
candidates.quote: **예측 요약 + 지난 변경의 판정 + 질문 답(바뀐 것만)**. 건강 지표는 경보로만 남긴다.
candidates.harness: Restrict briefing inputs to these items and present health metrics only as alerts.

candidates.rule: Every rec.brief choice must provide a metric name from the ledger and a judgment window in hours, defaulting to 2; the tool must reject a choice without either field.
candidates.quote: `metric`(장부의 지표 이름)과 `window_h`(판정 시간, 기본 2)를 **필수**로. 없으면 툴이 거절한다.
candidates.harness: Require metric and window_h fields and reject incomplete choices.

candidates.rule: A choice may change only one area: either one playbook role or one restock action, so effects can be judged without overlap.
candidates.quote: 한 선택지가 바꾸는 영역은 하나(playbook의 역할 하나 또는 restock 하나)로 제한. 동시에 여러 곳을 바꾸면 판정이 겹친다.
candidates.harness: Reject choices that change multiple roles or combine a role change with restocking.

candidates.rule: Include the agent's own historical performance in audit inputs.
candidates.quote: 감사 입력에 자기 과거 성적([나])을 넣는다.
candidates.harness: Add the agent's past performance to audit inputs.

candidates.rule: Commit analysis logs so they are available to the user and strategy agent; preserve strategy/URGENT.md as the operator-facing report of current anomalies.
candidates.quote: 사용자 (운영) | 지금 이상한 것 | `logs/strategy/URGENT.md` (그대로)
candidates.harness: Keep the urgent report unchanged for the operator and commit analysis logs for the user and strategy agent.

candidates.rule: User notes use the format '# YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM — question' and expire from briefings after six hours.
candidates.quote: `user_notes.md` 형식: `# YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM — 질문` (6시간 지나면 브리핑에서 빠진다, 0장).
candidates.harness: Enforce the note format and omit notes older than six hours from briefings.

candidates.rule: The listed analysis and documentation work does not require stopping sales or purchases; the outer-loop change requires one outer restart, which does not affect trading.
candidates.quote: **판매·구매를 멈출 필요가 없다.**
candidates.harness: Keep trading running during this work; restart only the outer loop when applying the outer-loop change.

candidates.rule: If trading is intentionally stopped during steps 5 and 6, stop the kit as well because the kit watchdog will restart the seller.
candidates.quote: 키트 watchdog가 seller를 되살리므로 키트째 멈춰야 한다.
candidates.harness: Stop the whole kit, not only the seller, when pausing trading for those steps.

candidates.rule: Improving food payment conversion through expiration protection or food-preservation timing is a strategy change, not a harness change; decide separately after v5 judges its effect.
candidates.quote: 안쪽을 바꿔야 하는 일(식품 결제 전환 올리기: 유통기한 보호 v66의 효과, 가게의 식품 보존 시간 맞추기)은 하네스가 아니라 **전략**이고
candidates.harness: Keep these changes out of the harness and make a separate strategy decision after evaluating their effects.

candidates.rule: Verify that buyer_orders payments over six hours equal payments.jsonl payment count, and that shop_visits sales equal the shop's settlement count in the ledger.
candidates.quote: `buyer_orders`의 6시간 결제 수 = `payments.jsonl`의 결제 수, `shop_visits`의 판매 = ledger의 우리 정산 수.
candidates.harness: Run both flow reconciliation checks.

candidates.rule: Verify that recalculating percentiles from the current snapshot reproduces the board's ALL percentile using the existing core/score.py validation method.
candidates.quote: 지금 스냅샷으로 다시 계산한 백분위 = 보드의 `all`
candidates.harness: Run the snapshot-to-board percentile consistency check.

candidates.rule: Check that the retrospective experiment ledger marks v66 and v67 as overlapped.
candidates.quote: v66·v67이 `overlapped`로 나오는지.
candidates.harness: Validate the retrospective labels for v66 and v67.

candidates.rule: The design's adoption and whether to add or remove questions from the fixed analysis list remain undecided.
candidates.quote: 이 설계대로 갈지 (특히 [라]의 질문 목록에 더하거나 뺄 것).
candidates.harness: Treat adoption and changes to the question list as decisions still requiring confirmation.

candidates.rule: The judgment window is unresolved: strategy changes every 30 minutes, proposed judgments use the time one change has been active (at least 30 minutes), and samples below 30 are marked indeterminate; whether consecutive changes in the same area should be grouped is also unresolved.
candidates.quote: 표본이 30 미만이면 "판단 불가". 같은 영역을 연달아 바꾼 것은 묶어서 판정할지.
candidates.harness: Mark samples below 30 as indeterminate and ask whether consecutive same-area changes should be grouped.

candidates.rule: Restricting each choice to one area is an unresolved decision that reduces the strategy agent's freedom.
candidates.quote: 선택지가 바꾸는 영역을 하나로 제한하는 것 (전략 에이전트의 자유를 줄인다).
candidates.harness: Do not treat the one-area restriction as a confirmed user decision until it is approved.

candidates.rule: Whether to stop trading while making the changes remains an unresolved decision; the design says stopping is unnecessary, but describes how to stop safely if desired.
candidates.quote: 거래를 멈추고 할지, 멈추지 않고 할지.
candidates.harness: Ask whether trading should be paused; if it is paused for steps 5 and 6, stop the whole kit.
